checks.explanation: Robinhood is actively building products (custodial accounts, trust accounts) aimed at capturing the generational wealth transfer and reports growing assets under custody, but the prediction's core claim (Robinhood becomes 'the number one' institution capturing the $130 trillion transfer) is a decades-long competitive superlative that can't be scored this early against established wealth managers.

sources.title: Robinhood Unveils the Future of Family Finance
